summary: Corporación América Airports S.A. filed a Form 6-K with a press release reporting July 2026 passenger traffic. Total passenger traffic rose 1.4% year-over-year, with international traffic up 7.1% and domestic down 7.8%. The report details country-level performance, including a decline in Argentina domestic traffic due to reduced Flybondi capacity, and growth in Armenia, Italy, Brazil, and Uruguay. This is routine operational disclosure of monthly metrics, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No deal terms, strategic actions, or corporate event are involved, so no category applies beyond the ordinary reporting of operating statistics.
